params.body: X-Timing-Detail: groups on the Stocklist list render (66 queries): 25x option_values, 8x option_groups, 7x countries. The options filter panel printed each option's values and group lazily; the card prices ask dealer->country for the VAT conversion. Options now load with values and group and sit in the facet cache; dealer.country joins the card eager load. Expected: about 26 queries per render.
